understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to move every selectable piece onto a goal tile marked '+'. When multiple goals existed, all of them had to be occupied simultaneously for the level to register a win.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement shifted the selected piece by one grid cell, while walls or other objects could block movement. Adjacent pushable blocks could be moved by attempting movement into them, whereas walls were impassable. CLICK selected a selectable piece using its pixel/grid coordinate, allowing control to switch between pieces. Each action consumed a limited step, including clicks and ineffective movement attempts.

understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to move every selectable piece onto a goal tile marked '+'. When multiple goals existed, all of them had to be occupied simultaneously for the level to register a win.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement shifted the selected piece by one grid cell, while walls or other objects could block movement. Adjacent pushable blocks could be moved by attempting movement into them, whereas walls were impassable. CLICK selected a selectable piece using its pixel/grid coordinate, allowing control to switch between pieces. Each action consumed a limited step, including clicks and ineffective movement attempts.
